title: isochilus major var. amparoanus
intro: Isochilus major var. amparoanus, commonly known as the amparo orchid, is a type of orchid plant that belongs to the Isochilus genus. The amparo orchid is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include its ability to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and expectorant properties, making it a sought-after remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the amparo orchid include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
